adjudication.rationale: In GoogleCalendarService.updateEvent and deleteEvent, the new fallback logic is incorrect when externalCalendarId is falsy. The code now does `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId` (and similarly for delete). If `externalCalendarId` is undefined/null, the `find` predicate compares `cal.externalId` to undefined/null, which will not match any normal calendar entry, so the fallback yields `undefined` instead of using the event’s destination calendar. This can lead to passing an undefined calendarId into `calendar.events.update`/`calendar.events.delete` (or at minimum failing to select the intended calendar), which is a behavioral regression from the prior `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` fallback.
